stem: What is the most likely reason Cody "decided to go easy" on Mud?
instruction:
Read the sentences from paragraph 1.

He decided to go easy on him. After all, Mud wasn’t the greatest soccer mind —at least when it came to video games.

options.label: A
options.text: Cody believes he is a better soccer player than Mud.

options.label: B
options.text: Cody thinks Mud should be prepared for how different soccer is from video games.

options.label: C
options.text: Cody feels the rest of the team has more practice at soccer video games than Mud.

options.label: D
options.text: Cody wants Mud to be the best soccer player on the team.

visual_elements: He decided to go easy on him. After all, Mud wasn’t the greatest soccer mind —at least when it came to video games.
